title: Verdant 49 — Hallowfield Halloween Tileset for RPG Maker MZ, Tiled, Godot & Unity: Pumpkins & Jack-o'-Lanterns [16x16]
shortText: Halloween tiles: pumpkin beds, flickering jack-o'-lanterns, a bubbling witch's cauldron. For MZ, Tiled, Godot and Unity.
description:
A Halloween harvest for your map: 313 tiles at 16x16 in one 67-colour palette, with jack-o'-lanterns that flicker, a witch's cauldron that bubbles, pumpkin beds you paint like terrain, and the autumn field and lane of Verdant Seasons, tile for tile. Commercial use permitted in unlimited projects, no attribution required; you may not resell the tiles themselves as an asset pack.

What is in it

  • 12 objects: round pumpkin, small pumpkin, tall pumpkin, white ghost pumpkin, pile of pumpkins, cluster of gourds, carved jack-o'-lantern (unlit), carved white ghost pumpkin (unlit), two carved pumpkins, stacked, prize pumpkin, apple-bobbing tub, corn shock. Each ships transparent for your own ground and grounded on ours, with a contact shadow drawn from that ground's own colours.
  • 3 animated objects, 24 tiles: two carved jack-o'-lanterns with candle light that flickers unevenly, so a field of them never blinks in step, and a cauldron of violet brew with bubbles and a wisp of vapour. 4 frames each at 160 ms.
  • 235 transition tiles in 5 complete 47-mask sets: pumpkin beds dug into the field or right against the lane, fallen leaves drifted over either, and Seasons' own field-to-lane set.
  • 16 fill tiles: the pumpkin bed (dark tilled soil with clods and green vine runs), a carpet of fallen leaves, and Seasons' autumn field and lane.
  • A finished 40x24 sample map, The Pumpkin Lane, with 50 objects placed, as PNG, JSON and a Tiled .tmx.

Engines

  • Unity: copy importers/Unity/Verdant49Hallowfield/ into your project and run one menu command (Tools > CSAF Verdant > Verdant 49 Hallowfield > Build Unity Assets). It builds 313 pixel exact sprites and Tiles, 5 RuleTile brushes, 6 AnimatedTiles and a scene holding the sample map. Tested in a blank Unity 6000.5.7f1 project: every RuleTile drew the right tile in all 256 neighbour arrangements (1,280 of 1,280) and Unity's render of the scene matched the sample map pixel for pixel. Brushes need the free 2D Tilemap Extras package.
  • Tiled: one .tsx per sheet with every animation and its timing written in; Tiled 1.12.2's own renderer drew the sample map identical to ours (983,040 px, 0 differ), and drew it again at 8 points in time with the lanterns and the cauldron on the right frame each time (1,966,080 px).
  • RPG Maker MZ: every set on the A2 sheet as MZ's own autotile brush; every shape was composed back out of the sheet with MZ's own autotile table (240 of 240 identical). Tested against the table, not inside the MZ editor. Objects on the B and C sheets; MZ does not animate object tiles, so the animation frames are there as tiles.
  • Godot 4: one TileSet, loaded and verified in Godot 4.7.2 (313 tiles built). The TileSet carries no animation.

The proofs

Every tile's wrap boundary is measured against its own interior, and every 4x4 repetition is rendered and reviewed. Grid, palette and autotile completeness are machine-proven: every tile is exactly 16x16, every pixel is inside the 67-colour palette, and alpha is strictly on or off. The autumn field, the lane and the field-to-lane set are Verdant Seasons' own tiles, byte for byte, so the two packs lay flush.

More from the series

Verdant Seasons is the same field and lane in spring, summer and winter, and Verdant 06 — Gothic is a chapel and churchyard for the night itself.

AI disclosure

Every tile is generated by our own procedural drawing engine, which is AI-written software. No image model, no scraped art and no training dataset were used, and nothing was traced.
